newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN PAIR TOPPLE J-LEAGUE LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN PAIR TOPPLE J-LEAGUE LEADERS.

text.p: Goals by Brazilians Cesar Sampaio and Valber helped Yokohama Flugels to a 2-0 win over J-League league leaders Kashiwa Reysol.
Kashiwa's defeat toppled them from the top after just three days as leaders.
Gamba Osaka, 2-1 winners at Kashima, moved back to top of the table on goal difference ahead of the Flugels, Kashiwa and Kashima.
However, Gamba paid a price for the win when Cameroon
striker Patrick Mboma was sent off for a second heavy tackle.
Sampaio headed Flugels' first goal in the 57th minute. Valber's fine, solo effort eight minutes later sealed their win.
Pre-season favourites Nagoya ended a six-game run without a win by beating Urawa 3-1 at home but remain rooted at the foot of the 17-team table.
Brazilian Magrao found the net twice to lead Kawasaki to a 4-2 win over J-League newcomers Vissel Kobe.
